entry.name: BorderSize
entry.label: Border thickness
entry.tooltip: How thick the drawn border is, in pixels. 0 hides the border entirely.

entry.name: BorderRadius
entry.label: Corner radius
entry.tooltip: Rounds the corners, in pixels. 0 gives square corners. Capped at half the window so small windows stay sane.

entry.name: BorderOnUndecorated
entry.label: Draw on windows without a server-side decoration
entry.tooltip: Needed for CSD and borderless windows, which is most of them on Wayland. Turn this off if you use a decoration that draws its own frame and you only want the ring on decorated windows.

entry.name: DrawOnDecorated
entry.label: Also draw where a decoration is present
entry.tooltip: Off by default: with a server-side decoration this draws a second frame just outside the first, which most people do not want.

entry.name: ActiveBorderSource
entry.label: Active border colour
entry.tooltip: Where the colour of the focused window's border comes from.

entry.name: ActiveBorderColor
entry.label: Custom active colour
entry.tooltip: Used when the active border colour is set to a custom colour.

entry.name: ActiveBorderColor2
entry.label: Gradient end colour
entry.tooltip: The gradient runs from the custom active colour to this one. Used when the active border colour is set to a custom gradient.

entry.name: BorderGradientAngle
entry.label: Gradient angle
entry.tooltip: Direction the gradient runs, in degrees. 0 is left to right, 90 is top to bottom.

entry.name: BorderGradientSpin
entry.label: Gradient rotation speed
entry.tooltip: Degrees per second the gradient rotates. 0 leaves it still. Applies to the custom gradient only.

entry.name: ShowInactiveBorders
entry.label: Draw borders on unfocused windows
entry.tooltip: Off by default, so only the focused window is outlined. On, every tiled window gets a border in the inactive colour.

entry.name: InactiveBorderSource
entry.label: Inactive border colour
entry.tooltip: Where the colour of unfocused windows' borders comes from. Only used when borders on unfocused windows are on.

entry.name: InactiveBorderColor
entry.label: Custom inactive colour
entry.tooltip: Used when the inactive border colour is set to a custom colour.

entry.name: Debug
entry.label: Log to the journal
entry.tooltip: Writes a line per re-tile to the KWin journal. Off by default; it is noisy and never needed in normal use.

entry.name: DebugVerbose
entry.label: Log every tracked window
entry.tooltip: Adds per-window detail to the journal log, including the cull decisions. Only useful when diagnosing a border that will not appear. Implies the log above.
